name: p6_kfib
statement: noncomputable def p6_kfib (k : ℤ) (n : ℤ) : ℤ := ((!![k, 1; 1, 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) ^ n) 0 1
informal: k-Fibonacci number f_n for all integer n (f_0=0, f_1=1, f_{n+1}=k f_n+f_{n-1}), defined as the (0,1) entry of M^n, M=[[k,1],[1,0]], as in the paper's matrix formula
